lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The wreck is warm. It shouldn't be.

lines.speaker: sparrow_pilot
lines.text: Okay. The walls are... cells? Like honeycomb, but soft. Keep talking to me, Captain.

lines.speaker: sparrow_pilot
lines.text: Found something. A hex-shaped pod with a rack of... those are missiles. Six. And a launcher that's still twitching.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Bring it. Bring all of it. If we'd had that an hour ago—

lines.speaker: sparrow_pilot
lines.text: Captain, Wren's and Kite's guns. It didn't blow them up. It cut them off. Like it wanted the pieces.

lines.speaker: li
lines.text: (relay, recorded hours ago) Vey, me again. Halcyon's making good time. Whatever the lane throws at you: see you at Meridian.

lines.speaker: captain
lines.text: (quietly) Three escorts out, one ship home. See you at Meridian, Li. I'm holding you to it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Kestrel logs three names: Priya Nandakumar. Sefa Lowe. Dov Ancell.
